pk: sriraGavendratirTa tadupahiteti kartrsanavetakriyaPalasalitvasya laksanatvadityarTa paragiti bahyatvantaratvarupatvadityarTa iti na syaditi kartrprayogo na syadityarTa Bedakarya-niti BedapratiniDitvadvisesasya sonapratiniDi putikan yaTa sonakaryan karoti taTeti Bava atiprasanga syaditi pranitaBede jivesvaradavapi visesa evaByupeyo na Beda ityarTa sati pranane Bedakarye pranane satityarTa tata eveti pranitakaryasya nirvahakantaraBavadeveti va pranananirvahakaBavoBayanyaTanupapatita eveti va arTa anyatreti ‘Bedahine tvaparyayasabdantaraniyanaka viseso nana kaTita sosti vastusvasesata ’2 ityadina anuvyaKyanabrhadBasyadavityarTa pratyaktvan antaratvan paraktvan bahisWatvan evan tarhiti GawapawayorapyaBedanangikrtya Bedakaryasyaparyayavyavaharasya visesadevopapatO BedanatrocCeda syadityarTa satiti aBedaBedakaryayo sadBave ‘pranane sati’ ityarTa tanirvahaketi Bedakaryaparyayavyavahara-nirvahaketyarTa GawapawayostvaBedo na prananapranita iti Bava
ck: srirakaventratirta tatupahiteti kartrsanavetakriyapalasalitvasya laksanatvatityarta parakiti pahyatvantaratvarupatvatityarta iti na syatiti kartrprayoko na syatityarta petakarya-niti petapratinititvatvisesasya sonapratiniti putikan yata sonakaryan karoti tateti pava atiprasanka syatiti pranitapete civesvaratavapi visesa evapyupeyo na peta ityarta sati pranane petakarye pranane satityarta tata eveti pranitakaryasya nirvahakantarapavateveti va pranananirvahakapavopayanyatanupapatita eveti va arta anyatreti ‘petahine tvaparyayasaptantaraniyanaka viseso nana katita sosti vastusvasesata ’2 ityatina anuvyakyanaprhatpasyatavityarta pratyaktvan antaratvan paraktvan pahistatvan evan tarhiti katapatayorapyapetanankikrtya petakaryasyaparyayavyavaharasya visesatevopapatO petanatroceta syatityarta satiti apetapetakaryayo satpave ‘pranane sati’ ityarta tanirvahaketi petakaryaparyayavyavahara-nirvahaketyarta katapatayostvapeto na prananapranita iti pava
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ तदुपहितेति कर्तृसमवेतक्रियाफलशालित्वस्य लक्षणत्वादित्यर्थः परागिति बाह्यत्वान्तरत्वरूपत्वादित्यर्थः इति न स्यादिति कर्तृ

pk: sriraGavendratirTa vyaKyataprayaniti ‘niTyeti tavadanirvacaniyaniti vaktun na sakyate tasya-prananikatvadina nirastatvat tato niTyetyasatve vaktavye niTyaButan paranityasya nasti paraniti niTyaButan tadvisayatvanityasya nasti paravisayatvanityarTa syat taTa ca kaTanatna prakasa’ iti niTyapranatrtvaniti vakyavyaKyanaritya vyaKyataprayanityarTa nuktatnaniti tasya paravisayatve sansarapatena tatprakasasya svaparavisayakatvenaprakasatvarupasyapranatrtvarupasya ca jaqatvasya tatranEkantyanityarTa anyaTa nuktatvavyaGataditi Bava visvasatyatvavadinataritya sankate- nanu suktiti sankaya utaranaha- syataditi
ck: srirakaventratirta vyakyataprayaniti ‘nityeti tavatanirvacaniyaniti vaktun na sakyate tasya-prananikatvatina nirastatvat tato nityetyasatve vaktavye nityaputan paranityasya nasti paraniti nityaputan tatvisayatvanityasya nasti paravisayatvanityarta syat tata ca katanatna prakasa’ iti nityapranatrtvaniti vakyavyakyanaritya vyakyataprayanityarta nuktatnaniti tasya paravisayatve sansarapatena tatprakasasya svaparavisayakatvenaprakasatvarupasyapranatrtvarupasya ca catatvasya tatranEkantyanityarta anyata nuktatvavyakatatiti pava visvasatyatvavatinataritya sankate- nanu suktiti sankaya utaranaha- syatatiti
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ व्याख्यातप्रायमिति ‘मिथ्येति तावदनिर्वचनीयमिति वक्तुं न शक्यते तस्या-प्रामाणिकत्वादिना निरस्तत्वात् ततो मिथ्येत्यसत्त्वे

pk: sriraGavendratirTa iti trtiyaniti yadi jaqatvan naneti vakyavyaKyane vikalpitanityarTa jaqatvasidDiriti aprakasatvarupeti yojyan taditi tatra nirvisayatvepyatnana prakasarupatve prananaBavadityarTa nanvasvaprakasatvan jaqatvanityetatkuto nasankitanityata aha- prakasatvasyEveti nanu visayasunyasya Gawasya prakasatvaBavadatnanopi visayavarjitasya prakasatvaBava eva yukta drswanusarini hi kalpaneti nyayaditi cet tatraha- na hi sarvEriti BavE padarTE grhyata iti nanahan jananityatretyarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta iti trtiyaniti yati catatvan naneti vakyavyakyane vikalpitanityarta catatvasitiriti aprakasatvarupeti yocyan tatiti tatra nirvisayatvepyatnana prakasarupatve prananapavatityarta nanvasvaprakasatvan catatvanityetatkuto nasankitanityata aha- prakasatvasyEveti nanu visayasunyasya katasya prakasatvapavatatnanopi visayavarcitasya prakasatvapava eva yukta trstanusarini hi kalpaneti nyayatiti cet tatraha- na hi sarvEriti pavE patartE krhyata iti nanahan cananityatretyarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ इति तृतीयमिति यदि जडत्वं नामेति वाक्यव्याख्याने विकल्पितमित्यर्थः जडत्वासिद्धिरिति अप्रकाशत्वरूपेति योज्यम् तदिति तत्र न

pk: sriraGavendratirTa aTeti drsyatvadihetudvayanirasanantaranityarTa niTyatvarupasaDyavikalpe hetvadi-vikalpena1 ca prak sananyato nirasadvisesata ityuktan uktaviDayeti ‘jaqatvancapranatrtva-neva na ca pranatrtvanatnanastErangikriyate atastadapyanEkantikaneva’ iti taTa ‘atnanopi drsyatvadanEkantikata ca’ ityadinoktaviDaya cetyarTa aganeti ‘gOranadyantavati’ ‘akasavatsarvagatasca nitya’ ‘prakrti purusascEva nityO kalasca satana’ iti ‘sadeva sonyedanagre’1 ‘aTa nartyonrto Bavati’2 ityadyaganetyarTa drsyatvadihetuna ‘neha nanasti kincana’3 ityadyaganErva taniTyatvan setsyatityata aha- drsya-tvaderiti ukteti niTyatvadi-vikalpadinoktadusanaganetyarTa baDadivaksyananetyarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta ateti trsyatvatihetutvayanirasanantaranityarta nityatvarupasatyavikalpe hetvati-vikalpena1 ca prak sananyato nirasatvisesata ityuktan uktavitayeti ‘catatvancapranatrtva-neva na ca pranatrtvanatnanastErankikriyate atastatapyanEkantikaneva’ iti tata ‘atnanopi trsyatvatanEkantikata ca’ ityatinoktavitaya cetyarta akaneti ‘kOranatyantavati’ ‘akasavatsarvakatasca nitya’ ‘prakrti purusascEva nityO kalasca satana’ iti ‘sateva sonyetanakre’1 ‘ata nartyonrto pavati’2 ityatyakanetyarta trsyatvatihetuna ‘neha nanasti kincana’3 ityatyakanErva tanityatvan setsyatityata aha- trsya-tvateriti ukteti nityatvati-vikalpatinoktatusanakanetyarta patativaksyananetyarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ अथेति दृश्यत्वादिहेतुद्वयनिरासानन्तरमित्यर्थः मिथ्यात्वरूपसाध्यविकल्पे हेत्वादि-विकल्पेन१ च प्राक् सामान्यतो निरासाद्विश

pk: sriraGavendratirTa anEkantikatvaBivyaktyarTanatnana ityetadvisinaswi- vipaksaButasyeti hetutvasidDi-riti anEkantyaBavaditi Bava tatsidDO cetyanantaran tena hetuneti yojyan nanvatnani gatopi Bedarupo vastuta paricCinatvahetu niTyeti cena nanaBavat 2Bedo niTya Bedatvadityadyanunanadinan Bavadityata aha - Bedeti vaksyananeti pratyaksabaDitan cetyadina vaksyananabaDadityarTa yadva yatpraguktanavidyavilasito jivesvarajaqarupo Bedaprapanco na paranarTa iti taniraha- BedaniTyatveti atnano Bedanupapatiriti niTyaButaprapancapratiyogikaBedasyapi niTyatvadityarTa taTa ca nanEkantyaniti Bava prapancaniTyatvasidDavityanantaran atnani tatpratiyogikaBedasyapi niTyatvapraptya vyaBicaraBavena vastuta paricCinatvasya hetutvasidDirityarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta anEkantikatvapivyaktyartanatnana ityetatvisinasti- vipaksaputasyeti hetutvasiti-riti anEkantyapavatiti pava tatsitO cetyanantaran tena hetuneti yocyan nanvatnani katopi petarupo vastuta paricinatvahetu nityeti cena nanapavat 2peto nitya petatvatityatyanunanatinan pavatityata aha - peteti vaksyananeti pratyaksapatitan cetyatina vaksyananapatatityarta yatva yatprakuktanavityavilasito civesvaracatarupo petaprapanco na paranarta iti taniraha- petanityatveti atnano petanupapatiriti nityaputaprapancapratiyokikapetasyapi nityatvatityarta tata ca nanEkantyaniti pava prapancanityatvasitavityanantaran atnani tatpratiyokikapetasyapi nityatvapraptya vyapicarapavena vastuta paricinatvasya hetutvasitirityarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ अनैकान्तिकत्वाभिव्यक्त्यर्थमात्मन इत्येतद्विशिनष्टि- विपक्षभूतस्येति हेतुत्वसिद्धि-रिति अनैकान्त्याभावादिति भावः तत्सिद्

pk: sriraGavendratirTa 2yacoktan prak ‘vinata atnana paranatnano na Bidyante atnatvat’ iti tanapi hetunatidesena paracaswe- eteneti ‘atnatvahetu satyo niTya va adye tavasidDi antye nanasidDi’ ityadirupenoktavaksyananabaDadidosagrastatvenetyarTa visisyapi niraha- tatKalvityadina uktarityeti ‘atnanopi drsyatvat’ ityadina uktadisa, ‘na ca pranatrtvanatnanastErangikriyate’ ityuktadisa, ‘tacaprakasatvanatnana’ ityuktaritya ‘vastuta paricCinatvanatnanopi’ ityuktaritya casidDanityarTa drswantasceti paranatna hi tvaya drswantatayokta tatra coktaritya adrsyatvadirupanatnatvanasidDaniti saDanavikala ityarTa nirastatvaditi anirvacaniyasya nirasaniTyetyasyasadityarTatvadatnatvan nastityuktan syat tatascasidDisaDanavEkalye Bavata iti Bava atiprasaktatvaditi dehadavapya-ropitatnatvasya satvadityarTa drswantasceti paranatnarupo drswanta ityarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta 2yacoktan prak ‘vinata atnana paranatnano na pityante atnatvat’ iti tanapi hetunatitesena paracaste- eteneti ‘atnatvahetu satyo nitya va atye tavasiti antye nanasiti’ ityatirupenoktavaksyananapatatitosakrastatvenetyarta visisyapi niraha- tatkalvityatina uktarityeti ‘atnanopi trsyatvat’ ityatina uktatisa, ‘na ca pranatrtvanatnanastErankikriyate’ ityuktatisa, ‘tacaprakasatvanatnana’ ityuktaritya ‘vastuta paricinatvanatnanopi’ ityuktaritya casitanityarta trstantasceti paranatna hi tvaya trstantatayokta tatra coktaritya atrsyatvatirupanatnatvanasitaniti satanavikala ityarta nirastatvatiti anirvacaniyasya nirasanityetyasyasatityartatvatatnatvan nastityuktan syat tatascasitisatanavEkalye pavata iti pava atiprasaktatvatiti tehatavapya-ropitatnatvasya satvatityarta trstantasceti paranatnarupo trstanta ityarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ २यच्चोक्तं प्राक् ‘विमता आत्मानः परमात्मनो न भिद्यन्ते आत्मत्वात्’ इति तमपि हेतुमतिदेशेन पराचष्टे- एतेनेति ‘आत्मत्वहेतुः

pk: sriraGavendratirTa evaniti atnanopi drsyatvadityadiprakarenetyarTa saDaraneti sarvanunanadi-saDaranadusanenetyarTa atnaBedaBavasceti pratyaksabaDita ityanvaya atnaBedaBavasceti ‘ajnata calpasaktitvan duKitvan svalpakartrta sarvajnatadisagunavirudDahyanuButiga ’ ityuktaprakarena pratyakse Darnini BedakaDarnasaksatkarasya Bedasaksatkaravyaptatvena jivesu paranatna-pratiyogikaBedasyapi pratyaksasidDatvena ‘vinata atnana paranatnanastatvato na Bidyante’ ityanu-nanena saDyanano BedaBava pratyaksabaDita ityarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta evaniti atnanopi trsyatvatityatiprakarenetyarta sataraneti sarvanunanati-sataranatusanenetyarta atnapetapavasceti pratyaksapatita ityanvaya atnapetapavasceti ‘acnata calpasaktitvan tukitvan svalpakartrta sarvacnatatisakunavirutahyanuputika ’ ityuktaprakarena pratyakse tarnini petakatarnasaksatkarasya petasaksatkaravyaptatvena civesu paranatna-pratiyokikapetasyapi pratyaksasitatvena ‘vinata atnana paranatnanastatvato na pityante’ ityanu-nanena satyanano petapava pratyaksapatita ityarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ एवमिति आत्मनोऽपि दृश्यत्वादित्यादिप्रकारेणेत्यर्थः साधारणेति सर्वानुमानादि-साधारणदूषणेनेत्यर्थः आत्मभेदाभावश्चेति प्रत्य

pk: sriraGavendratirTa baDyatvan kuta ititi viroDitayoktapratyaksasya prabalyanirupanaditi Bava anu-nananiti niTyatvasaDakanunananityarTa upajivyatveneti Darnigrahakatayeti yojyan ‘vacaranBanan vikaro nanaDeyan’ (Can. 6.4.1) iti srutya pratyaksena grhitan vikarasabditan Gawadikananudya ‘yo vikarasa vacaranBanan vagalanbananatran niTya iti yavat’ ityarTavarnanat ‘draswa jiva ato brahnana anyo nasti’ ityarTakaTanat draswradesca Bedena satvena ca grahanadupa-jivyatvaca tadbaDitatvena nirasta ityarTa kaTanupajivyatetyata aha- tasanapiti visayeti anuvadyetyarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta patyatvan kuta ititi virotitayoktapratyaksasya prapalyanirupanatiti pava anu-nananiti nityatvasatakanunananityarta upacivyatveneti tarnikrahakatayeti yocyan ‘vacaranpanan vikaro nanateyan’ (can. 6.4.1) iti srutya pratyaksena krhitan vikarasaptitan katatikananutya ‘yo vikarasa vacaranpanan vakalanpananatran nitya iti yavat’ ityartavarnanat ‘trasta civa ato prahnana anyo nasti’ ityartakatanat trastratesca petena satvena ca krahanatupa-civyatvaca tatpatitatvena nirasta ityarta katanupacivyatetyata aha- tasanapiti visayeti anuvatyetyarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ बाध्यत्वं कुत इतीति विरोधितयोक्तप्रत्यक्षस्य प्राबल्यानिरूपणादिति भावः अनु-मानमिति मिथ्यात्वसाधकानुमानमित्यर्थः उपजीव्यत

pk: sriraGavendratirTa upajivyasyapi niravakasenopajivakena baDadarsanat pratyaksanunanayorapi viparita evastu baDyabaDakaBava iti niravakasatananunanaderupapadayanaha- nanvastvityadina baDa-sabdarTanaha - svavisayatpracyavayituniti baDitunityarTa asya vakyasyagrepyanvaya aBisarpaneti rajO sarpaBrane sati pascat nayan sarpa aBisarpanadansanaPanonayanadisunyatvaditi lingena baDadarsanadityanvaya upajivakeneti Branarpitavisayopajivanaditi Bava savakasasyeti aprananatayeti Bava upajivyasyeti niseDyavisayarpakatayeti yojyan nanvidan rajatanityatra dvavansO tatra yadanse upajivyata na tadansenunanadibaDa yadrupyanse baDa tadanse ca nopajivyata ata uktanyayasya na vyaBicara iti Bavena sidDanti sankate-tatredantanatraniti purvapaksi utaranaha- tarhi prakrteti GawapawadiDarnyansanatranupajivya niTyatvanunanade pravrtirastu, na satvansanupajivyetyarTa
ck: srirakaventratirta upacivyasyapi niravakasenopacivakena patatarsanat pratyaksanunanayorapi viparita evastu patyapatakapava iti niravakasatananunanaterupapatayanaha- nanvastvityatina pata-saptartanaha - svavisayatpracyavayituniti patitunityarta asya vakyasyakrepyanvaya apisarpaneti racO sarpaprane sati pascat nayan sarpa apisarpanatansanapanonayanatisunyatvatiti linkena patatarsanatityanvaya upacivakeneti pranarpitavisayopacivanatiti pava savakasasyeti aprananatayeti pava upacivyasyeti nisetyavisayarpakatayeti yocyan nanvitan racatanityatra tvavansO tatra yatanse upacivyata na tatansenunanatipata yatrupyanse pata tatanse ca nopacivyata ata uktanyayasya na vyapicara iti pavena sitanti sankate-tatretantanatraniti purvapaksi utaranaha- tarhi prakrteti katapatatitarnyansanatranupacivya nityatvanunanate pravrtirastu, na satvansanupacivyetyarta
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ उपजीव्यस्यापि निरवकाशेनोपजीवकेन बाधदर्शनात् प्रत्यक्षानुमानयोरपि विपरीत एवास्तु बाध्यबाधकभाव इति निरवकाशतामनुमानादेरुपपा

pk: sriraGavendratirTa pratyaksanatra iti upajivyatvadihinapratyaksa ityarTa sidDaniti baDyan syadityanu-karsa nanuktan BranasidDa sarpadirbaDyo drswa iti tatraha - sarpeti balavatpratyakseneti nedan rupyaniti pratyaksan sayuktikatvena balavaditi yojyan vipakse baDakenanunanabaDyatvanaha- anu-nanenEveti vyavasTa veti pratyaksanatran nanunanadibaDyan upajivyan tu sutaran na baDyan pratyuta baDakanevetyevan vyavasTetyarTa pratijnatanaganabaDyatan ca vyanakti-aptavakyaditi sarpaBranaderityanukarsa nanu Branternivartanano na nulapratyaksan jnatva nivartata ityaha-ata eveti nulapratyaksena nivartanadevetyarTa evaneveti adrswvEvetyarTa anyaTeti pratyaksasyaganabaDa ityarTa jEniniye tatsidDisutre yajananakaryakaratvagunayogena prastare yajananasabdo gOna ityuktva pratitanuKyaBedaruparTapracyavanan krtan tatyajyan syadityarTa nuKyarTa evaByupeya syat vyavasTa veti pratyaksan naganabaDyaniti vyavasTa vetyarTa nanu pratyaksatvavisesat kaTan pratyaksan pratyaksasya baDakaniti tatraha- pratyaksaniti pariksitanapavadasunyan nirdosatvenavaDaritaniti va niscitaprananyakaniti varTa anyenetiti anunanadinetyarTa tadidanityanena ca yadi pratyaksanatranityadinoktan paranrsyate
ck: srirakaventratirta pratyaksanatra iti upacivyatvatihinapratyaksa ityarta sitaniti patyan syatityanu-karsa nanuktan pranasita sarpatirpatyo trsta iti tatraha - sarpeti palavatpratyakseneti netan rupyaniti pratyaksan sayuktikatvena palavatiti yocyan vipakse patakenanunanapatyatvanaha- anu-nanenEveti vyavasta veti pratyaksanatran nanunanatipatyan upacivyan tu sutaran na patyan pratyuta patakanevetyevan vyavastetyarta praticnatanakanapatyatan ca vyanakti-aptavakyatiti sarpapranaterityanukarsa nanu pranternivartanano na nulapratyaksan cnatva nivartata ityaha-ata eveti nulapratyaksena nivartanatevetyarta evaneveti atrstvEvetyarta anyateti pratyaksasyakanapata ityarta cEniniye tatsitisutre yacananakaryakaratvakunayokena prastare yacananasapto kOna ityuktva pratitanukyapetarupartapracyavanan krtan tatyacyan syatityarta nukyarta evapyupeya syat vyavasta veti pratyaksan nakanapatyaniti vyavasta vetyarta nanu pratyaksatvavisesat katan pratyaksan pratyaksasya patakaniti tatraha- pratyaksaniti pariksitanapavatasunyan nirtosatvenavataritaniti va niscitaprananyakaniti varta anyenetiti anunanatinetyarta tatitanityanena ca yati pratyaksanatranityatinoktan paranrsyate
s: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थ प्रत्यक्षमात्र इति उपजीव्यत्वादिहीनप्रत्यक्ष इत्यर्थः सिद्धमिति बाध्यं स्यादित्यनु-कर्षः ननूक्तं भ्रमसिद्धः सर्पादिर्बाध
